verdict.rationale: Intuit's developer docs give the QuickBooks Workforce (payroll) API a schema/GraphQL reference, samples, and use-case examples with testing guidance. Every developer profile also gets a sandbox company to run requests against. Nothing shows an interactive in-browser API explorer or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable in-doc examples, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
